page_note: Heavily damaged page (93.9%) containing the conclusion of the Two Trees teaching (segs 0-12) and the opening of a chapter on Eudaimonia/Sophia/Power (segs 14-32). Both teachings are substratic cosmological correspondences — Two Trees maps two cosmic principles; Eudaimonia/Sophia/Power maps a triad that exists at multiple cosmic levels (worldly vs. Father in the great land of Light). The fatigue score reflects the dialogue/ecclesial frame inserted at segs 16-17 introducing the new chapter, but this is a single editorial seam, not pervasive overlay. The teaching itself dominates.
